title: Traversal, which provides AI agents for site reliability engineering, raised $120M co-led by Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint, and Khosla at a $1B valuation (Rashi Shrivastava/Forbes)
summary: Rashi Shrivastava / Forbes: Traversal, which provides AI agents for site reliability engineering, raised $120M co-led by Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint, and Khosla at a $1B valuation — Traversal has raised $120 million in funding to help companies like American Express and Pepsi troubleshoot site outages. — for The Prompt
